title: deyeuxia ovata var. nivalis
intro: Deyeuxia ovata var. nivalis, commonly known as Snow Needle Grass, is a type of flowering plant that belongs to the Poaceae family. This plant is used in traditional medicine for its various health benefits, including the treatment of respiratory issues, fever, and digestive problems. The therapeutic actions of Snow Needle Grass include anti-inflammatory, antipyretic, and expectorant properties, which help to relieve congestion and coughs. The bioactive constituents of Deyeuxia ovata var. nivalis include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
